about: Where an objective is done, or where the arrow leads for a quest's giver or ender, anchored on the quest (never a line). forge-writer applies each record to the guides it writes, every build; forge data check-corrections checks this file; FORGE.md, Fixing a generated guide, has the format. objective: the objective's number (as in `quest Q.N`), "giver" or "ender". at: { map, x, y, frame }; path: { map, frame, points } for a target that walks a road (a loop of gotos before the goal); write: true gives the objective its own goal line from the data before the quest's bare complete. A record with faction (Alliance or Horde) holds for that side's routes only. Each record has a note, its source ({ kind, ref }, the kinds of forever-db/README.md) and its issue or pr.

places.note: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak: Yeti Fur drops from every Hillsbrad yeti, so the goal toured eleven spots, eight of them in the northern cave of Mountain and Giant Yetis (32-34) where The Abominable Greench (36, elite) roams, at a route level of 31. The Cave and Ferocious Yetis (30-32) of the Foothill Caverns carry it as often: the arrow points at their densest spot (16 of their 33 spawns within 2.5 map units), as for the Horde's Helcular's Rod (#1695).

source.ref: items.json 3720 Yeti Fur: dropped by 2248-2251; npcs.json spawns of 2248 and 2249 on map 1424 at 42-47,25-34, of 2250 and 2251 at 36-47,3-13
rec index 2026-11-11: 565.4 ticks by 5 people at 32-33

places.note: The Burning of Spirits (1435): the Infused Burning Gem is filled on any Burning Blade cultist, so the goal toured sixteen spots, half of them the Mannoroc Coven's Summoners and Invokers (38-40) in southern Desolace, at a route level of 33. The step is at Thunder Axe Fortress, whose cultists (30-33) are the ones meant: the arrow points at the fortress's densest spot.

source.ref: the goal's droppers: Burning Blade Augur, Reaver, Adept, Felsworn, Shadowmage, Seer (30-33) at Thunder Axe Fortress (Desolace 52-57,22-33); Burning Blade Summoner and Invoker (38-40) at 49-55,71-79 and 79-82,77-81

places.note: Down the Scarlet Path's Undead Ravagers (261) on Desolace's south loop: the goal's arrow toured the bone fields of the Valley of Bones, where Magram Necrokhans and Corpsefeeders (45, elite; Shen'dralas spawns on the same ground) and Magram Necromancers (42) walk among the Ravagers, at a route level of 38.8. The arrow points at the fields' western edge, on a Ravager's spawn (3 Ravager spawns within 60 yd, 7 within 100, 13 within 150), with no elite or mob 3 levels over within 40 yd; 15 of the 18 people who killed Ravagers in the recordings did so within 60 yd of it.

source.ref: npcs.json spawns: Undead Ravager (11561) on map 1443 at 58.3-65.2,81.5-92.1; Magram Necrokhan (253274), Corpsefeeder (253394) and Magram Necromancer (253272) on Shen'dralas (map 2652), over the bone fields at Desolace 59.6-65.9,85.1-94.2
danger gate (players' recordings to 2026-11-12): the Ravagers done by 18 people at a median level of 38.0, nobody died within 60 yd

places.note: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up (6134) on Desolace's south loop: the Crate of Ghost Magnets' point (63.5,91.6) put it among Magram Necrokhans and Corpsefeeders (45, elite; Shen'dralas spawns over the Valley of Bones) at a route level of 38.8; players' recordings show 5 deaths within 60 yd of it. The crate works anywhere on the bone fields: the arrow points at the spot players used it on the fields' eastern side (Shen'dralas 33.5,29.0), 10 yd from the Magrami Spectre's spawn that drops the Ghost-o-plasm, with no elite within 40 yd; 59 of the 64 Ghost-o-plasm ticks in the recordings (all 8 people) came within 60 yd of it.

source.ref: players' recordings: Ghost-o-plasm objective ticks of 8 people on the bone fields, one at Shen'dralas 33.6,28.9; danger gate: 5 and 3 deaths within 60 yd of the old Ghost Magnets and Ghost-o-plasm points

places.note: Blisters on the Land: the Fen Creepers are hunted along the Wetlands' river and the Sundown Marsh waterways, not the few by Rethiel the Greenwarden. In game the reporter ran out of creepers at the spot by the giver and found enough at 24.46,33.18 (#610). Players' recordings (2026-11-09: 9 people, 101 kills) show the creepers killed all along the river from 48 to 35 (y 25-35) as well as at 24-26: the arrow now walks the river east to west from Einar Stonegrip's road, ending at the reporter's cluster, instead of crossing the zone to 24.46,33.18 and back to Rethiel (1,067 + 1,335 yd).

places.note: Helcular's Rod drops from every yeti of the Hillsbrad hills (about one in sixteen), so the goal toured eleven spots, eight of them in the northern cave of Mountain and Giant Yetis (32-34) around the Flame of Uzel. The quest is taken at 29 on the 29-33 Hillsbrad guide, so players were sent to farm mobs 3-5 levels above them (#1695). The Cave and Ferocious Yetis (30-32) of the Foothill Caverns west of Tarren Mill carry it as often: the arrow now points at their densest spot (16 of their 33 spawns within 2.5 map units). Players' recordings: 18 people got the rod, 15 of them in the caverns, at levels 29-34 (median 31); the three who got it in the northern cave did so at 29 and 32.

source.ref: items.json 3708: dropped by 2248 Cave Yeti (30-31), 2249 Ferocious Yeti (31-32), 2250 Mountain Yeti (32-33), 2251 Giant Yeti (33-34), 6% each; npcs.json spawns of 2248 and 2249 on map 1424 at 42-47,25-34, of 2250 and 2251 at 36-47,3-13
